claims.statement: Antonio da Vinci's tax return lists Leonardo, aged five, as the illegitimate son of Ser Piero and a woman named Caterina.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Florentine catasto declaration, 1457.
